The recent changes by VHC have made things far worse for lots of patients, for example, now you’re told to go online, fill out a form, then wait two days, or more in some cases, for a response which is outrageous really, you dont even get a confirmation to your phone or email in many cases to confirm your request has been sent.

Calling isn’t much better even when you’re first in the queue, it can take 10–15 minutes to get through sometimes, and you rarely reach anyone who can actually address your concerns, they can only make notes on the system and sometimes those staff taking the calls are quite indifferent, which is not only very frustrating but actually quite disgraceful.

I was advised to call 111 or go to A&E if I felt that my issues were serious, which is actually no help to me at all, I have already spoken to a nurse who was super and she gave me some guidance on managing my condition, and she then said, you got it, 'I advise you speak with your GP and explain your circumstances and see if they can provide further help and possibly any referrals'.

I also have no idea who my GP is now, it has changed 2-3 times in the last 18 months, not usually an issue, until you have to fill out a form and they want your GPs name.

The whole system feels broken and makes it rather frustrating for many folks and many folks feel neglected by this practice, I have now been waiting almost two weeks to actually speak with someone about my current issues, and yes I did fill out their crappy Triage form, and yes I did speak with someone via 111, the only people who have let me down thus far is my GPs surgery.

I know for a fact that a lot of people simply give up trying when attempting to get anything from this
